The Fennoman Program: The fennomans' demand in one statute: Finnish shall be the language of the courts, the offices and the schools of the land. The svecomans will protest
German: the officials will learn to decline Finnish nouns.

The Fennoman Program: Kantele players at the manor gate and runic singers on the festival stage: state patronage for the old songs and crafts, so that the nation's memory becomes the nation's pride.

The empire is convulsed, the moment is at hand: Finland declares herself a sovereign republic among the nations, by right and by the will of the Diet. Let the bells ring from the gulf to the far hills.

The name says what it means: United Baltic Provinces - all of them. Let the Lithuanian lands stand under the same crown as the Estonian and Latvian ones, three nations, one state, from the gulf to the Niemen.
The Latvian shore belongs with the Estonian one: the Daugava road and the song grounds under the same flag, as the awakening's founders always intended.
The kindred peoples of the gulf look to the south shore: let our presses print their songbooks, our universities seat their scholars, and our friendship stand openly with the Finns.
